turns.question: For outreach messages sent between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that got a reply, what was the 75th percentile of hours between the message and the reply?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no reply-latency or percentile metric, so I can't give the 75th percentile of hours between a message and its reply. The closest metrics are messages_replied (outreach messages that got a reply), reply_rate, replies and messages_sent, which count or share messages but do not measure time to reply.
